productionStandard.masterFirstRule: The approved artwork master is the only visual source of truth. Convert that exact artwork into an ordered path or stroke representation; never design a substitute Live illustration.
productionStandard.newStrokeRule: One record equals one continuous brush-reveal gesture; authored order controls replay; maximum 100 gestures in 30 seconds with equal gesture timing.
productionStandard.masterRevealRule: The immutable approved raster master is revealed through stage-specific masks derived from its actual painted pigment pixels; do not redraw or simplify the master.

artworks.title: A Rainy Tea Afternoon
artworks.moment: A quiet cup beside a rain-streaked window
artworks.palette: mostly black ink on warm ivory paper; rare vermilion accents

drawingSequence.notes: Strong confident structural strokes establish the setting and sill.
Flowing main branch first, then only a few selected leaves.
Long, elegant, restrained lines in the distance.
Only enough roof and building strokes to reveal it.
Careful, simple outlines; very few defining details; paper remains visible inside objects.
Red sun, maple leaves and tiny intended accents appear last.

artworks.replayRequirement: The encoded paths array in rainy-tea-afternoon-001.json must follow these six stages in order. The renderer reveals paths progressively in stored array order; it does not create named stage pauses.

artworks.title: A Clear Day at the Maple Pavilion
artworks.moment: The original painted maple pavilion beneath an open sky, revealed with expressive brush movements
artworks.replayRequirement: Replay reveals the immutable painted master using 100 ordered brush-shaped gestures with equal timing across 30 seconds. Stage masks retain the source pigment pixels; sequence is thick structure, attached thin details, air/birds/little things, leaves, then sun and finish.
